summary: Line-reading dispatch. Tests flag field at this+0x10 (this[4]); if non-zero calls LineInputReader(*this, a2, a3), else calls FileReadUntilNewline(a2, a3, *this). Either branch reads a line from the FILE* stored at this+0x0 into buffer a2 and returns it. Shared by 29 callers across loaders, parsers and settings readers.

operations.description: Branch on flag field this[4] (offset this+0x10): non-zero selects LineInputReader path, zero selects FileReadUntilNewline path.
LineInputReader(*this, a2, a3): dereference stream/buffer pointer stored at this+0x0 as first argument.
FileReadUntilNewline(a2, a3, *this): read until newline into buffer a2 with size a3 from the FILE* stored at this+0x0.
Return the char* produced by whichever line-reading callee the guard dispatched to.
